notes.title: Get ready for a new challenge 🌙
notes.content:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44363917/7c8122fb6d4bf2ead3e3dfa663e276784a1adebc.png

In this new challenge, you have to find 3 pieces of the lost Moon, a golden artifact that will give you access to an extra level!

There are no hints about where or how to find the hidden pieces of the Moon, they are in some of the boxes and you need to use all your brain skills to make it

Good luck!
